Iconography

Generated from code 252 glyphs in the CtrlChain icon font

Every glyph in the platform icon font, rendered from the font itself — so the page cannot list an icon that does not exist.

Usage

Icons come from the CtrlChain icon font — 252 glyphs — through cca-icon. The icon input is typed, so an unknown name is a compile error rather than an empty square.

template
<cca-icon icon="arrow-right" /> <!-- Size comes from font-size, so a type utility sets it --> <cca-icon icon="warning" class="text-xl" /> <!-- Inside a button the size follows the button size input --> <button ccaButton size="small"> <cca-icon icon="plus" /> Add stop </button>

Icons are text, not images

Size is font-size and colour is color, which is why an icon inherits from its container and why ccaButton can resize its icon per size input without any per-icon markup.

No glyph matches that name.

11 names are not lowercase-kebab

Most glyph names look like arrow-right, but 11 do not: alignCenter, alignJustify, alignLeft, alignRight, android-face-Icon, Bold, Gear-Settings, Italic, orderedList, Underline, unorderedList. The icon input is case-sensitive, so the admin rail item is icon="Gear-Settings" — gear-settings is a compile error. The filter above is case-insensitive, so searching gear still finds it.

Where this comes from

Every value on this page was read out of the platform source at build time, so it cannot drift from the app. Regenerate with pnpm design-system:export.
